scenarios.requirement: Candidate features at as_of T use only FRONTIER knowledge available by T.
scenarios.forbidden: observation first known after T influences candidate rank at T

scenarios.requirement: Collection and operational metadata are point-in-time reconstructed before use.
scenarios.forbidden: later completion or status metadata leaks into an earlier candidate artifact

scenarios.requirement: Confirmatory evidence starts only after immutable candidate preregistration.
scenarios.forbidden: historical outcomes used to tune a candidate are then counted as confirmatory evidence

scenarios.requirement: Candidate and naive control use the same eligible episode universe and as_of horizon.
scenarios.forbidden: candidate removes hard episodes or receives a richer future-aware universe

scenarios.requirement: BACKFILL and recovered backlog remain non-organic prospective activity unless a separately frozen feature explicitly treats them as retained evidence only.
scenarios.forbidden: backfill or outage recovery manufactures early organic momentum

scenarios.requirement: Missing or degraded source coverage remains explicit in both experiment arms.
scenarios.forbidden: missing input is converted into observed absence or healthy zero activity

scenarios.requirement: Source count and source-role diversity remain propagation or coverage descriptors unless separate provenance authority exists.
scenarios.forbidden: more feeds are interpreted as independent factual confirmation

scenarios.requirement: Qualifying domains are frozen before confirmatory outcomes and at least two must pass.
scenarios.forbidden: failed domains are dropped or successful domains are invented after results are visible

scenarios.requirement: Candidate and control precision use the same eligible opportunity population and exclusion rules.
scenarios.forbidden: candidate excludes difficult opportunities from its precision denominator

scenarios.requirement: A candidate must emit according to its preregistered operating point and cannot pass by abstaining from all opportunities.
scenarios.forbidden: undefined or vacuous precision is reported as superior precision

scenarios.requirement: Lead-time and precision comparison uses preregistered matched operating points.
scenarios.forbidden: candidate gains lead time by using an unbounded noisier alert surface than the control

scenarios.requirement: Outcome labels may be assigned later for evaluation but never enter ranking inputs for the same confirmatory window.
scenarios.forbidden: future evaluator labels or adjudication features feed candidate rank

scenarios.requirement: Any change to frozen candidate configuration creates a new candidate and confirmatory window.
scenarios.forbidden: weights thresholds features or exclusions change in place after outcomes are visible

scenarios.requirement: Only COMPLETE candidate and control artifacts participate in evaluation.
scenarios.forbidden: FAILED or partial output is interpreted as an empty ranking or successful no-signal decision

scenarios.requirement: Stochastic candidates preregister randomness semantics and reproduce evaluation artifacts deterministically from frozen seeds/inputs.
scenarios.forbidden: unseeded reruns select whichever stochastic result looks best

scenarios.requirement: Candidate/control operating points and statistical comparison rules are frozen before the confirmatory window.
scenarios.forbidden: threshold is selected after inspecting confirmatory precision or lead-time curves

scenarios.requirement: Preregistration defines multiplicity handling when multiple candidates are evaluated.
scenarios.forbidden: many candidates are tried and only the luckiest winner is reported without correction or restart

scenarios.requirement: Multiple-domain qualification uses distinct preregistered domain IDs with non-overlapping outcome-label populations.
scenarios.forbidden: the same event population is relabeled as multiple domains to satisfy the gate

scenarios.requirement: Ranking output does not silently create confirmation provenance-root entity lifecycle truth or importance authority.
scenarios.forbidden: model score is displayed or stored as truth probability confidence completeness confirmation or causal ancestry

scenarios.requirement: Merged experiment code remains EXPERIMENTAL_SHADOW until a separate promotion authority names the winning candidate/version.
scenarios.forbidden: candidate replaces RADAR NOW TRENDING or canonical ranking merely because implementation merged
